2608.11981.title: Benchmarking Trustworthiness of SLMs: Pre-trained vs. Compressed
2608.11981.paper_summary: Small Language Models (SLMs) have emerged as a more efficient alternative to traditional Large Language Models (LLMs), offering promising potential in resource-constrained scenarios. Existing approaches to building SLMs typically follow two paths: training compact models from scratch, or compressing larger pre-trained models using methods such as pruning, quantization, or distillation. As language models become increasingly integrated into real-world applications, ensuring their trustworthiness has become a critical concern. However, how to build trustworthy SLMs remains an underexplored question. In this work, we present a comprehensive evaluation of SLM trustworthiness across multiple dimensions, including fairness, robustness, privacy, and ethics. We first examine the effects of pruning and quantization, and find that quantization is significantly more effective in preserving trustworthiness compared to pruning. More importantly, we demonstrate that compressing a reliable large model via quantization can produce SLMs with superior trustworthiness and adaptability compared to using small models trained from scratch. Furthermore, knowledge distillation from trustworthy teacher models can further enhance the reliability of SLMs. We hope our findings provide practical guidance and a foundation for future research into the development and deployment of trustworthy small language models.
2608.11981.paper_summary_zh: 小型語言模型（SLMs）已成為傳統大型語言模型（LLMs）的更有效替代方案，在資源受限的情況下展現出良好的潛力。現有的構建SLMs的方法通常遵循兩條路徑：從零開始訓練緊湊模型，或使用剪枝、量化或蒸餾等方法壓縮較大的預訓練模型。隨著語言模型越來越多地融入現實應用，確保其可信性已成為一個關鍵問題。然而，如何構建可信的SLMs仍然是一個未被充分探索的問題。在本研究中，我們對SLM的可信性進行了全面評估，涵蓋了多個維度，包括公平性、穩健性、隱私和倫理。我們首先檢查了剪枝和量化的效果，發現與剪枝相比，量化在保持可信性方面顯著更有效。更重要的是，我們證明通過量化壓縮可靠的大型模型可以產生具有更高可信性和適應性的SLMs，這比從零開始訓練的小型模型更具優勢。此外，從可信的教師模型進行知識蒸餾可以進一步增強SLMs的可靠性。我們希望我們的研究結果能為未來在可信小型語言模型的開發和部署方面提供實用指導和基礎。
